name: 85340 · Litchfield Pk, AZ
findings: ZIP 85340 (Litchfield Pk) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85340 (Litchfield Pk) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
